audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has three entries where four are expected (packet defect), and the content layer carried zero cooldown-sequencing cues (packet: sequencingCues 0) — no 'wait for X before you Y' anywhere in win/whys/spikes/early/mid/late/wants.
audit.why: His E is a FLAT 10s at every rank and it is his only mobility, so 'commit in the ten seconds after his E' is a real, checkable instruction. Purgatory is 120/100/80s. Those two numbers are the whole sequencing story and the content layer had neither.
audit.corrected: spikes[3] created with before:null (a late-game entry on his seal scaling). 10s E written into whys[5], spikes[1].text, early, mid and wants.you[1]; the 120s R written into whys[4] and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: His W is described nowhere in either layer. It grants Attack Speed and Move Speed, damages HIM during the effect, and only heals back a portion of that damage AT THE END of the duration — so damage that kills or routs him before the duration expires denies the refund entirely.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Locke ignites his soul, gaining Attack Speed and Move Speed, and dealing damage to himself. At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect.' That is a genuine burst-window interaction on an 18/17/16/15/14s cooldown, and it also explains why report[8].t's note that 'his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal' is correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why asserted a specific execute threshold ('disengage above ~15%'). No threshold appears anywhere in the kit text.
audit.why: A precise-looking percentage a player will position around, with nothing behind it, is worse than saying 'the threshold'. Riot's text says only that Purgatory 'potentially executes enemies hit'.
audit.corrected: The ~15% replaced with the verified 120s cooldown and 'leave the zone rather than test it'.

notes:
This page is the strongest in my slice — chart consistent across both layers and the packet, real voice, real interactions. My edits only close the two packet defects (missing 4th spike, zero sequencing cues in the content layer) and remove one unverifiable number.

NAME I COULD NOT VERIFY — flagged rather than changed: the page calls his Q 'Ritual Nails (Marks)' throughout (focus.text, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t), but the kit's own description says 'Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw'. packet.enemyAbilities is NULL for Locke, so unlike every other matchup in this slice there is no authoritative name list to check against, and 'Ritual Nails' could legitimately be the ability name with 'Soul Nails' being the projectiles. Per the do-not-speculate rule I changed nothing. If 'Soul Nails' is the ability name, this is a Brand/Pyroclasm-class error sitting on 382 games — the largest sample in my slice — and it is repeated in six strings.

Also unverified and left alone: 'E (Ashen Pursuit)' in breakdown.cooldowns, and the repeated '125 range' attack-range claim in phases[0].why, breakdown.early, breakdown.wave and report[4].t. Locke's kit lists ability ranges (Q 950, W 250, E 425, R 1000) but no basic-attack range.
